policy: Audit every immutable locked MLB winner against FINAL outcomes joined outside the frozen vector. Every locked winner remains an official-card prediction regardless of playability. The rolling official-card authority target is 90%; 50/60/70/80 are reporting-only milestones. Clean-vector status controls ML training eligibility, not the official-card accuracy denominator. ROI is not a promotion gate.
